name: Analyse Impulse Response
description: Analyse impulse responses (IRs): acoustic parameters such as EDT, T20 and C50, and the time and frequency responses for Plot 2D, of each source-receiver pair chosen. Computed in the compas_acoustics worker.

inputParameters.name: irs
inputParameters.description: ImpulseResponse object(s), as Simulate gives them. Sources and receivers are numbered over the responses as connected, in the order they come: the n-th distinct source (receiver) is source (receiver) n, so a filtered or reordered list renumbers the pairs.

inputParameters.name: source_idx
inputParameters.description: Index or indices of the source(s) to analyse, counted over the connected responses. Dropdown: All, or 'n: name'. Empty analyses every source.

inputParameters.name: receiver_idx
inputParameters.description: Index or indices of the receiver(s) to analyse, counted over the connected responses. Dropdown: All, or 'n: name'. Empty analyses every receiver.

outputParameters.name: parameters
outputParameters.description: One branch per source-receiver pair, path {receiver;source}: the list of acoustic parameters: 'EDT', 'T20', 'T30', 'C50', 'C80', 'D50', 'DRR', 'Ts', 'STI' (with its modulation transfer index per band), 'G', 'SPL', 'LF' and 'LFC'. G and SPL (the sound pressure level from the source's level at 1 m, overall A-weighted) only for a simulated response; LF and LFC, the early lateral energy fractions, only for an ambisonic one. Each title ends with ' - source to receiver'.

outputParameters.name: time
outputParameters.description: One branch per source-receiver pair, path {receiver;source}: the impulse response against time, for Plot 2D or a panel: the W channel of an ambisonic response, both ears (left, right) of a binaural one. Right-click the output to choose the scale: dB (default), the level re the peak, floored 100 dB below it, over the whole response; or linear, the amplitude, ending 5 % after the Schroeder curve has fallen 60 dB, below which the amplitude is not visible. The parameters and the frequency output use the whole response.

outputParameters.name: frequency
outputParameters.description: One branch per source-receiver pair, path {receiver;source}: the frequency response, 1/3-octave smoothed, 20 Hz to 20 kHz in dB re the peak, for Plot 2D or a panel: the W channel of an ambisonic response, both ears (left, right) of a binaural one.
